answers.core: It should be part of the core engine since it's not heavy weight and right at home with the other light sources.
answers.workaround: This feature will be commonly used. Especially for those who are previewing assets they've made in a DCC tool like Maya or Blender and want to render them in-engine. Environment Artists who needs precision with their light sources. Arc-Vis and Engineers who need to craft a basic lighting set ups that are accurate. This shouldn't take long to make since a lot of the work has already has been completed only needing those specific additions.
